summary: Off-registry dependency fetched from mutable GitHub raw tarball URL
details: package.json declares its sole dependency node-acct-utilssss21 as a direct HTTPS URL to a tarball hosted on a personal GitHub account's repository via a mutable branch ref (https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/refs/heads/main/node-acct-utils-1.0.0.tgz), with no version pin and no integrity hash. On npm install, npm downloads whatever bytes that URL currently returns and installs them, running any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball. The shipped index.js is an inert stub, so the installed behavior is entirely determined by the content of the remote tarball, which the GitHub repo owner can change at any time. The dependency name also does not correspond to any established registry package and is suffixed with repeated characters, consistent with a lure manifest whose only purpose is to pull in the off-registry payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
